name: God Helmet classic (Murphy's Shiva 2-phase session)
origin: Todd Murphy (Shiva God Helmet software), modelled on the Persinger & Koren two-phase procedure; run once in Persinger's lab (Collins 2014, three participants on this sequence)
summary: Todd Murphy's Shiva God Helmet session: 30 min of his 'modulated 40 Hz chirp' stepping round four coils on the right side, then 30 min of his amygdala signal stepping round both sides. Murphy models it on the Persinger lab's two-phase procedure; the lab's first signal was a different one, the Thomas pattern. Both signals are rebuilt here. Phase 1 can cause fear; press Skip to go straight to phase 2.
notes: The lab's procedure: the Thomas pattern, stronger on the right, for 20 or 30 min (Persinger 2000 p.3 [661]; St-Pierre 2006 p.10 [1088]), a questionnaire with the blindfold off (Saroka 2013 p.5 [399]), then burst-firing on both sides (persinger-saroka-2015-sensed-presence). Murphy gives no numbers for his chirp, only a falling frequency with Fibonacci-varied amplitude and gaps (mod40_chirp_consent.htm, 'TECHNICAL INFORMATION'). Here it is a 40 to 6 Hz sweep on 3-ms points, 2.5 s on and 1.5 s off, this project's choice, with fixed amplitude and gaps. The amygdala signal is the project's rising sweep with the Shiva software's length (289 points of 3 ms, 4 s between; Collins 2014); the point values were never published as numbers (the lab prints the shape only as a small figure). In phase 2 one left-right pair is on at a time, and the right side is reversed so that the pair's field points through the head. The 125 ms per step and the site names are this project's choice; Collins's text (solenoids 5 cm apart vertically, 8 cm horizontally) reads as a rectangle, not this cross. Field: Collins measured 1 to 2 uT in the centre of the cap (Collins 2014 p.69 [60]). This program's setting is the peak field 20 mm in front of each coil. At 1 uT the head centre gets a few hundredths of a uT. The lab tested this sequence once, 20 + 20 min in three people: right-frontal high-beta power rose, no presence result (Collins 2014 pp.64, 71 [55, 62]). Independent sham-controlled tests of God-Helmet-type fields found no field effect (Granqvist 2005, double-blind; Gendle & McGrath 2012, where the experimenter knew the condition). Do not endure an unpleasant phase 1. If anger or irritability appears during or after phase 2, never repeat the session. Not for people prone to anxiety or with epilepsy, migraine, brain injury, a psychiatric diagnosis or medication; no drugs or other mind machines.
setting: Dark, silent room ("silence, not just quiet"), blindfold, eyes closed, reclined; relax without meditating or falling asleep. Murphy says lab sessions ran mostly between midnight and 4 am; the one lab paper of this family that gives a time says between 18:00 and 22:00 (Cook 1997 p.5 [687]). For experiences during the session Murphy advises geomagnetic quiet (K 0 to 2). A helper can press Skip if phase 1 becomes frightening, so you stay in the dark.
schedule: At most once a week (Murphy: no more often than once a week); do not mix with other Shiva or Shakti sessions in the same weeks. Murphy advises starting with other sessions before this one.
